changelog: Fixed: a written-up order was refused with "SQLSTATE[22001]: Data too long for column 'unit'" when the Unit box held more than 20 letters — which a Gujarati unit like "ચોરસ ફૂટ પ્રમાણે" easily does. The column now holds 40, and anything longer is trimmed instead of throwing the whole order away.

The same guard now covers every box that has a fixed width: job number, customer name, address, GSTIN, email, pincode, contact name, designation and notes. Too much text is shortened on the way in; it can no longer stop a save.
A database error is no longer shown to the counter as a driver message. It now reads "The 'Unit' box has more text than it can hold — shorten it and save again", naming the box at fault.
The Unit and Job No boxes stop at 40 letters in the browser too, so the limit shows while typing rather than after pressing Save.
